comment:
* SMS Constants and must be the same as the corresponding
 * deprecated version in SmsMessage.
 *
 * @hide

variables.name: ENCODING_UNKNOWN
variables.comment: User data text encoding code unit size

variables.name: MAX_USER_DATA_SEPTETS
variables.comment: The maximum number of payload septets per message

variables.name: MAX_USER_DATA_SEPTETS_WITH_HEADER
variables.comment:
* The maximum number of payload septets per message if a user data header
     * is present.  This assumes the header only contains the
     * CONCATENATED_8_BIT_REFERENCE element.

variables.name: ENCODING_KSC5601
variables.comment: * This value is not defined in global standard. Only in Korea, this is used.

variables.name: MAX_USER_DATA_BYTES
variables.comment: The maximum number of payload bytes per message

variables.name: MAX_USER_DATA_BYTES_WITH_HEADER
variables.comment:
* The maximum number of payload bytes per message if a user data header
     * is present.  This assumes the header only contains the
     * CONCATENATED_8_BIT_REFERENCE element.

variables.name: FORMAT_UNKNOWN
variables.comment:
* Indicates unknown format SMS message.
     * @hide pending API council approval

variables.name: FORMAT_3GPP
variables.comment:
* Indicates a 3GPP format SMS message.
     * @hide pending API council approval

variables.name: FORMAT_3GPP2
variables.comment:
* Indicates a 3GPP2 format SMS message.
     * @hide pending API council approval
